correctness.rationale: For a fixed simple tree, source/sink indicator at a vertex has marginal q_v=2^{-d_v}; diagonal cross covariance is −q_v² and the only off-diagonal dependence occurs at adjacent ordered pairs, each contributing q_u q_v. Summation gives 2Σ_edges q_uq_v−Σ_vertices q_v². Substitution yields path (n−4)/16 and star (n−1)/2^(n−1)−(n−1)/4−4^−(n−1). For any nonstar, at most n−2 leaves and at least two leaf edges give a strict lower bound above star. For any nonpath, detach one pendant arm from an extremal branch vertex and attach it to another arm terminal; the exact covariance gain is ≥5/64, branch excess drops by one, and iteration reaches the path. n=2 and n=3 are handled separately. Independently enumerated every orientation of 47 unlabeled trees n=2..8 and reproduced the local formula and both extremal inequalities. Finite enumeration is diagnostic, not the general argument.
